chunks: But for those who fear their Lord, there are chambers above them, chambers built, with rivers flowing beneath them; (it is) the promise of God; God does not break the promise.

key_terms.لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ: God does not break the promise

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who fear their Lord according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'lofty mansions' (gharaf) are often interpreted as spiritual stations of proximity to God, with the rivers symbolizing the flowing knowledge and mercy of the Ahl al-Bayt. This verse underscores the concept of divine fidelity (al-wa'd al-haqq), assuring the faithful that God's promise of reward is absolute and unchanging, reinforcing the theological basis for hope (rajā') in the afterlife.
